title: Link two sentences
instructions: Read both sentences, then choose the words that link them.

parts.prompt: The new timetable gave students more time for lunch. ___, it left less time for the last lesson.

choice_rationales.A: Less lesson time is not presented as the expected result of a longer lunch.
choice_rationales.B: However shows that the second sentence gives the other side of the change.
choice_rationales.C: The second sentence is not an example of the longer lunch.
choice_rationales.D: More time and less time are different, not similar.

parts.hint: Is the second sentence a good point, or a problem with the change?
parts.correct_explanation: The first sentence gives a benefit and the second gives a cost, so a contrast word fits.
